reason: Unmaintained-crate warning (not a vulnerability) for zvariant 5.15.0, a zbus 5.x companion crate reached through the desktop shell's native-ui entry points. Accepted under Default B of the Rocinante security remediation plan v2, Phase 3, after Task 3.1 returned NOT-CHEAP: notify-rust's latest release 4.18.2 and ksni 0.3.7 both still declare zbus ^5, and no rfd release consumes ashpd ^0.14, so no maintained release path currently removes this warning.
exit_condition: a notify-rust release declaring zbus ^6, and a ksni release declaring zbus ^6 that a tray-icon release can consume, or the native-ui features are reworked — whichever first
